annotations.title: Send an enquiry to Cambridge China Bridge

description: Use only when the user has asked to contact Cambridge China Bridge or to get a quote: sends the user's sourcing enquiry or quote request to them by email, and they reply to the user directly. It sends only when user_confirmed is true, meaning the user has seen exactly what will be sent and agreed. All contact details are the user's own.

assistant.description: Which assistant is sending this (chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, copilot or other). Optional.

company.description: The user's company, if they gave one.

email.description: The email address to reply to.

message.description: Anything else the user wants to say.

phone.description: The user's phone number, if they want to give one.

product.description: What they want sourced: product, specification or link, quantity, target price.

source_page.description: The CCB page path the user was reading, if known. Path only, starting with /; no query or personal data.

user_confirmed.description: true only if the user has seen these details and agreed to send them.

name: submit_enquiry
